title: Measurement kit
intro: Measure so you can learn — not so you can invent a slide multiplier. Public research disagrees; your job is honest local instrumentation.
clocksAdvice: Freeze start dates deliberately (serious practice, cockpit, versioned harness).
Do not silently move starts to make ages look better.
Recompute ages from starts; quote the as-of date.

metrics.name: Tenure clocks
metrics.what: Calendar time since each frozen start.
metrics.why: Answers “how long have we been doing this?” without mythology.
metrics.trap: Back-dating to first curiosity instead of first real practice.

metrics.name: Harness size proxies
metrics.what: Counts of skills, rules, signed patterns over time.
metrics.why: Shows investment in the working relationship.
metrics.trap: Treating count as quality. Delete and deprecate ruthlessly.

metrics.name: Capability map
metrics.what: Outcomes tagged pre-AI feasibility vs now (solo-easy → impossible).
metrics.why: Captures scope expansion — the usual real win.
metrics.trap: Listing aspirations instead of evidenced outcomes.

metrics.name: Repeated-failure rate
metrics.what: How often the same class of waste recurs after a skill exists.

metrics.name: Proof pass rate
metrics.what: Fraction of agent-claimed dones that meet the proof class first time.
metrics.trap: Weakening the proof class to improve the score.

metrics.name: Harness tax log
metrics.why: Makes investment visible so it is not mistaken for pure slowdown.
metrics.trap: Endless meta-work with no product outcome.

metrics.name: Always-on token tax
metrics.what: Rough size of rules/skills/MCP catalog paid every turn before the ask.
metrics.why: Keeps the harness lean; context is rent.
metrics.trap: Optimising token counts while leaving idle specialty tools loaded.

comparisonBands.label: Solo mid (no AI)
comparisonBands.use: Baseline for routine tickets in a known stack.

comparisonBands.label: Solo senior (no AI)
comparisonBands.use: Baseline for hard debugging and design judgment.

comparisonBands.label: Two-person team (no AI)
comparisonBands.use: Compare when agent + human feels like pair pace.

comparisonBands.label: Small squad (no AI)
comparisonBands.use: Compare short parallel-lane bursts — rarely sustained.

comparisonBands.label: AI chat/complete, little harness
comparisonBands.use: Contrast raw assistance vs fail-closed compounding systems.

weeklyRitual: Update ages from frozen clocks (30 seconds).
Add at most three capability-map notes tied to real proof.
Propose or deprecate one pattern — do not let the registry rot.
Log harness tax if you spent a block encoding behaviour.
Refuse any external “N× productivity” claim without a cited method.
If the session felt heavy: note always-on tax and cut or unload one thing.
literatureNote: METR’s early-2025 RCT is the humbling baseline for familiar OSS tickets. Copilot lab/field studies show gains in other settings. Use both as context; instrument your own work.
